note: Acadia Parish has no queryable zoning district layer. The Police Jury adopts zoning (Municode Ch. 15) and Crowley publishes a zoning composite map only as a PDF (Feb 2012). ArcGIS searches for Acadia Parish found only parcel, boundary, and city-limit layers; the parcel layers (Tax_Parcel_CAMA_Joined_View, MobileMXD/0) carry no zoning field. Regrid's zoning is commercial, not official.
